name: Spell Check on Save
description: Checks spelling in comments and strings after file modification using cspell, reporting any misspellings found
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Check spelling after file write/edit
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -z "$FILE" ]]; then exit 0; fi
# Only check text-like files
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|md|txt|html|css)$ ]]; then
  if command -v npx &>/dev/null; then
    OUTPUT=$(npx cspell --no-progress --no-summary "$FILE" 2>/dev/null)
    if [[ -n "$OUTPUT" ]]; then
      COUNT=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
      echo "Spelling: $COUNT issue(s) found in $FILE"
      echo "$OUTPUT" | head -5
    fi
  fi
fi
exit 0
